# BarButton

The platform's top-bar control: a glass circle with a text-primary glyph, for a sheet's or screen's bar.

`NomNom.BarButton` · Chrome

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.BarButton icon={…} label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.BarButton" icon="{{…}}" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

A platform top-bar control: a glass circle with a text-primary glyph. `active` swaps to `<icon>-fill` (a filter that is on).

| prop | type | note |

| `icon` * | `IconName` |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  |
| `active` | `boolean` |  |
